init_wandb_singleton_logger: initialize a wandb singleton logger with config, run_id, project, entity, and log directory
log_metrics_with_wandb_singleton: log a dictionary of metrics to wandb using the singleton logger with optional step and commit
log_table_to_wandb: log a table with columns and data rows to wandb using the singleton logger
log_dataframe_to_wandb: log a pandas dataframe as a wandb table using the singleton logger
log_tensor_stats: log tensor statistics like mean, std, min, max to wandb using the log_stats convenience function
